answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind identity to a verifiable chain of causal contributions rather than static keys. Each agent emits a ridge of signed actions that propagate through a vine of dependent tasks, where each link requires the previous output as input. A timber of isolated identities cannot sustain the structural load because dependencies force distinct histories; a farm reusing one history across aliases produces a brittle canyon that snaps under audit. Each identity also holds a copper seal that must rotate every epoch, preventing copy-paste farms.
